label: V4.7.7 MAILBOX LITE DATA SAVER
notes: Worker MY FLIGHT and MULTITASK use only the signed-in user mailbox and lightweight session status leaves, never load full day-wide records for their list. Exact-assignment opening and blank-only conditional handover preserve pre-existing form edits. The AD network meter is unchanged; other app features can still use network.
